create_aria_processor: create an AriaProcessor instance with a tokenizer and optional size conversion mapping
call_aria_processor_with_text_and_images: call the AriaProcessor to tokenize text and process images into input_ids, attention_mask, pixel_values, and pixel_mask
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for given image sizes using the AriaProcessor
configure_aria_images_kwargs: configure AriaImagesKwargs with split_image, max_image_size, and min_image_size options
get_model_input_names: get the combined model input names from tokenizer and image processor via AriaProcessor
